---
title: "Data Zone & Locality Map: `r params$area`"
output:
  flexdashboard::flex_dashboard:
    vertical_layout: scroll
params:
  area: "South Lanarkshire"
---


### Data Zone, Locality, HSCP Map

This map shows the borders of Data Zone, Locality, and HSCP. This is based on new assignments of how Data Zones Localities provided by those in the respective Partnership.

Of the 32 HSCPs, `r check_hscp` have returned their new lookup files.


```{r, include = FALSE}

  geo_datazone_filtered <- geo_datazone |> 
    filter(hscp2019name == params$area)

  locality_sf <- geo_datazone_filtered |>
    group_by(hscp_locality) |>
    summarise(do_union = TRUE) |>  
    st_make_valid() |> 
    ungroup()
  
  test_locality_sf <- locality_sf |> 
    count(hscp_locality)
  
  hscp_sf <- geo_datazone_filtered |>
    group_by(hscp2019, hscp2019name) |>
    summarise(do_union = TRUE) |>   
    st_make_valid()  |> 
    ungroup()
  
  test_locality_sf <- hscp_sf |> 
    count(hscp2019name)
  
  # print(hscp_sf)
  
```

###

```{r}

  base_map <- geo_datazone_filtered %>%
    leaflet()  %>%
    addProviderTiles(
      providers$Esri.WorldTopoMap,
      options = providerTileOptions(opacity = 0.5)
    ) |>
    addPolygons(data = locality_sf,
                weight = 2.5,
                fillColor = ~pal(hscp_locality),
                color = ~pal(hscp_locality),
                fillOpacity = 0.3
    ) |>
    addPolygons(data = geo_datazone_filtered, weight = 0.5, color = "black",
                fillOpacity = 0, popup = ~glue("<br><b>HSCP</b>: {hscp2019name} (HSCP Code: {hscp2019})
                                              <br>
                                              <br><b>HSCP Locality</b>: {hscp_locality}
                                              <br>
                                              <br><b>DataZone Code</b>: {datazone2022}"),
                highlightOptions = highlightOptions(color = 'white', weight = 3.5, bringToFront = TRUE))

base_map
```
